review.note: No local historical execution is admitted. Fixed official frontend checks and immutable frontend/backend artifacts retain original producer identities. The fifth failed connected job supplies independently reverified 105 passed cases and nonempty upgrade preservation; the sixth failed connected job supplies five passed cases. No business test is repeated. Fresh schema, seed, font and narrowly authorized temporary permission preparation remain environment setup, not browser acceptance. Browser and restore remain required real execution. Seventh successful SAST authenticates prior application/control evidence; only three changed controls and Chrome helper plus its two affected tests are newly scanned. No prior failure is relabeled as a successful job.
